ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75-80% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the primary lobe surfaces against 20-25% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated at the median notch, trailing edges, and scattered circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity pigmentation mass radiating from the median notch. High-intensity fields dominate the lateral lobes. Distinct low-intensity circular rings (rosettes) distributed irregularly across both high-intensity fields. Continuous low-intensity band along the trailing edge and lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with a pixel angle approximately between 130 and 145 degrees; the vertex of the notch is partially occluded by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern; numerous jagged peaks and valleys (amplitudes of 5-15 pixels) create a highly non-linear boundary across both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharp, tapered tips; trajectory is symmetrical across the vertical axis.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous (approx. 30+) circular dark-ringed pixel clusters distributed across the high-intensity ventral surface of both lobes, representing localized contrast disruptions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark, unaligned linear pixel streaks visible on the right lobe, particularly near the outer edge and trailing margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface; significant jagged irregularities along the trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Dynamic water spray/splash occluding the lower-central region of the fluke base and median notch vertex.
